tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: List the integrations.at offering areas (AI at Work, Agentic Engineering, Enterprise AI, Training & Team Enablement). Each area carries its own pages and flyer downloads. Optionally restrict to one area by slug.

area.description: Optional area slug to restrict results to, e.g. ai-at-work

lang.description: Optional language, "en" or "de"; defaults to the page language

tools.name: send_contact_request
tools.description: Send a contact request to Integrations IT Solutions with the sender's name, company, email and message.
